title: Core crate: Merkle-CRDT per-group append-only log
description: Implement the per-group Merkle-CRDT append-only log in usenet-ipfs-core. Each group has a log of entries (timestamp, article_cid, operator_signature). Log tips are Merkle-hashed. Two peers reconcile by exchanging tips and performing set-union of missing entries, walking parent links for late-join backfill. Hybrid-logical-clock ordering ensures causal consistency without a coordinator.
notes: Prior art — Corundum two-tier timeline: Corundum organizes per-user content as a mutable current chunk (up to 256 entries) plus sealed immutable epochs, each with a Merkle root and prev-pointer chain. The ArchiveIndex provides O(1) lookup by sequence number. This is directly comparable to the usenet-ipfs per-group Merkle-CRDT log. Key differences: Corundum is per-user-per-operator; usenet-ipfs is per-group across multiple peers with CRDT merge semantics. The entry field shape (seq, prev, contentHash/CID, timestamp, retention) should inform the usenet-ipfs group log entry design even though the merge protocol differs.
